Learners create their own work applying Plan and execute design projects using the creative process, using ; the teacher supports individuals.

assessment: Assess the created work or performance on Plan and execute design projects using the creative process against a simple rubric (technique, effort, expression). conclusion: Three learners display or perform their work on Plan and execute design projects using the creative process; the class gives one kind, specific point of feedback each.
homework: Finish or improve the work you started today on Plan and execute design projects using the creative process and bring it to the next lesson.

starter_activity: Build on the previous lesson ('CREATIVE AND DESIGN PROCESSES'). Perform the first step of Plan and execute design projects using the creative process without explaining it and ask learners to predict what you will do next and why.
differentiation:
Support: Provide partially prepared materials or a simple pattern so learners can succeed at Plan and execute design projects using the creative process. while still doing the creative work themselves.
